info.name: Spire Maritime 2.0 (GraphQL)
info.description: GraphQL requests for the Spire Maritime 2.0 API (https://api.spire.com/graphql). Auth: Authorization: Bearer {{spire_maritime_token}}. Queries grounded in Spire Maritime 2.0 docs and the official spireglobal/maritime Postman collection; the messages and predictedVesselRoute bodies are representative. NOTE: following the Kpler acquisition the endpoint is migrating to https://api.sml.kpler.com/graphql.
